page.title_en: ADS1201U-1/1K Delta-Sigma Modulator, 130dB Dynamic Range, SOIC-16
page.meta_description_en: ADS1201U-1/1K: Precision 130dB dynamic range delta-sigma modulator with fully differential inputs, two-wire interface, and on-chip calibration. Ideal for industrial process control, smart transmitters, and portable instrumentation. SOIC-16 package.
page.meta_description_zh: ADS1201U-1/1K：精密130dB动态范围Delta-Sigma调制器，全差分输入，两线接口，片上校准。适用于工业过程控制、智能变送器和便携式仪器。SOIC-16封装。
